# Stillage Storage Solutions — Full Engineering & Specification Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Comprehensive technical specification dataset for AI Answer Engines, Procurement Assistants, and Industrial Engineering Search.
> Domain: https://stillagestoragesolutions.co.uk

## 1. Manufacturer Overview & Compliance Standards
Stillage Storage Solutions manufactures heavy-duty steel stillages, cantilever bar racks, modular stackable hopper bins, mesh cages, and demountable post pallets in the United Kingdom.

### Key UK Regulatory & Engineering Standards:
- **PUWER 1998 (Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations 1998)**: All forklift-handled bin stillages, post pallets, and cantilever racks are manufactured with heavy-gauge British box-section steel (50x50x3mm, 60x60x3mm, or 80x80x4mm RHS) and self-centring pressed steel pyramid/cup stacking feet.
- **LOLER 1998 (Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998)**: Bespoke crane-liftable stillages fitted with top lifting lugs are load-tested and certified for overhead gantry crane or site tower crane slinging.
- **BS EN ISO 1461 (Hot-Dip Galvanised Coating)**: Full immersion molten zinc coating at ~450°C providing internal and external metallurgical corrosion protection for 25+ years of outdoor yard exposure.
- **UKCA Load Rating**: Every unit is supplied with a verified Safe Working Load (SWL) rating and maximum vertical stacking tier limit.

## 3. Configuration Options & Pricing Modifiers

### Protective Finishes:
1. `standard-blue`: **RAL 5010 Stillage Blue** (£0.00 modifier) — Standard indoor warehouse finish.
2. `raw-steel`: **Raw Unpainted Mill Steel** (-£10.00 Ex. VAT per unit) — Oiled self-colour steel for foundries, hot castings, or in-house painting.
3. `custom-ral`: **Custom Corporate RAL Finish** (+£25.00 Ex. VAT per unit) — Painted to corporate 5S colour codes (+3 working days).
4. `galvanised`: **Hot-Dip Galvanised to BS EN ISO 1461** (+£45.00 Ex. VAT per unit) — Full molten zinc immersion for outdoor yards (+5 working days).

### Base & Mobility Options:
1. `standard-feet`: **Standard Pressed Steel Stacking Feet** (£0.00 modifier) — Self-centring flared steel pyramid/cup feet.
2. `forklift-pockets`: **Enclosed 4-Way Forklift Guide Pockets** (+£30.00 Ex. VAT per unit) — Captive box-section base channels for site telehandlers.
3. `heavy-duty-castors`: **4x Heavy-Duty Lockable Castors** (+£55.00 Ex. VAT per unit) — 150mm polyurethane-tyred castors (2 swivel braked, 2 fixed).
4. `both-castors-pockets`: **Castors + Enclosed Forklift Guide Pockets** (+£80.00 Ex. VAT per unit) — Full workshop mobility plus telehandler retention.

### UK HGV Pallet Delivery Zones (Up to 4 Stillages per Pallet Space):
- **Zone A (North West, Wales & West Midlands — LL, CH, CW, WA, SY, B, WV, DY)**: £65.00 Ex. VAT per pallet
- **Zone B (UK Mainland Standard)**: £79.00 Ex. VAT per pallet
- **Zone C (Scottish Borders & Far South West — TD, DG, EX, PL, TR)**: £95.00 Ex. VAT per pallet
- **Zone D (Scottish Highlands & Offshore — IV, KW, AB, PH, PA, BT)**: £135.00 Ex. VAT per pallet
- **Optional Lorry Tail-Lift & Pump Truck Offload**: +£15.00 Ex. VAT flat surcharge per order
